'''Synthefood''' was artificial [[Foodstuff/Legends|foodstuffs]] created by food synthesization plants. They were employed aboard the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first]] [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]] to keep the majority of the crew fed.
